properties.statement:
`add_decision`'s LOOP HINT SAYS 'lands proposed' EVEN WHEN THE WRITE LEFT THE NODE `accepted`, SO THE HINT INVITES A DEMOTION THE CALLER DID NOT MAKE. Alex's Grok 4.6 session, 2026-08-14, item 10, reported with unusual care: 'I did not accidentally demote this time; the hint still invites it.'

THE MECHANIC: `add_decision` is a merge. On a NEW node it lands `proposed`, and the hint is correct and useful. On an EXISTING node that is already `accepted`, the merge leaves the status untouched — correctly — and the same hint fires anyway, telling the caller a thing that is not true of the write they just made. An agent that believes it and 'corrects' the status with `set_decision_status` would demote a settled decision to `proposed` while thinking it was tidying up.

WHY THE BLAST RADIUS IS LARGER THAN A WORDING BUG: `dec:certainty-derived` makes status the carrier of the user's word, and `where-am-i` reads accepted Decisions back to the user as 'what you decided'. A silent demotion does not lose data — it withdraws a settlement, and the next session reads an open question where the user believes they closed one.

OBSERVED TWICE IN THIS PROJECT'S OWN HISTORY, which is what makes the hint dangerous rather than untidy: the brainstorm skill records that its step 2 ONCE READ 'this call is not optional: add_decision defaults to accepted' — true until 2026-07-25, then quietly false, and two dev_storyflow sessions measured and filed it independently on 2026-08-08. The skill was corrected to CHECK WHAT THE TOOL RETURNED rather than to name its default. THE HINT ON THE TOOL ITSELF WAS NOT GIVEN THE SAME TREATMENT.

FIX SHAPE: emit the hint only when the write actually created a node at `proposed`, or state the status the node now holds rather than the status a new node would have had. The information needed is in hand at the moment the hint is written.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether any Decision in any project has actually been demoted this way — he explicitly did not do it, and nobody has swept the snapshots for an accepted-to-proposed transition with no user behind it.

CLOSED 2026-09-29, 46 days after this report: fixed by reflow2 PR #623 (squash 449ba2b). Its change record, chg:a-loop-hint-says-where-the-node-landed, is in the committed design, not in this live store.

The hint now reads the status the node holds after the write, covering both the merge path reported here and the one-call settle path. It is pinned by a_loop_hint_says_where_the_node_landed.rs.

Still not established, as this finding said: whether any decision was ever demoted by an agent believing the old hint.
